BiblicalUsage: Aher is named once, in the genealogy of Benjamin, among the children of Ir and the sons of Aher — a verse scholars still debate, and the Chronicler's record is all we have.
TheologicalSignificance: No teaching hangs on this name. I leave the puzzle as it stands rather than forcing an answer the text does not give.
